with exactly:

(keep the curly apostrophes exactly as typed here, in the file's existing style). No other change to plot.md. Confirm both the frozen and the current package load (load_story_package) and that git diff of plot.md is one removed and one added line.
STEP 3. NEW experiment 'details' in the Stage 7 harness, reusing the transition machinery (full 2B continuation, max_commands 20, same caps as TRANSITION_CAPS, same checker semantics: earned_exit / timer_exit / no_exit): arms 'baseline' and 'details'. Both arms use the SAME 2A prompt: the recorded 2A turn-7 prompt plus the grounded additions derived exactly as the 'grounded' experiment derives them (current package vs bench/frozen/continuity-pre-2a-panel), so the prompt hashes are identical across arms and only the 2B continuation package differs: 'baseline' continues on bench/variations/stage7-details-control.json (story_package bench/frozen/continuity-pre-details, same 2A replay script as bench/variations/stage7-door-grounded.json), 'details' on bench/variations/stage7-door-grounded.json (the current package). The authored bridge/entry screen text is identical for both arms (the edit does not touch it); assert that in dry-run. Dry run must prove: identical 2A prompt hashes, the two continuation packages differ ONLY in the plot.md Details line, no network.
STEP 4. NEW scripts/ringer/stage7/payload_2b.py: offline, with sockets disabled and the provider transport stubbed to capture provider.last_prompt (see cloudflare.py near line 2050 where last_prompt is set; the earlier reconstruction used _continue's setup: load_variation, package_and_state(variation,'2B'), provider_for, provider.semantic_ask=None, RuntimeEngine, one engine.turn with the item-facts reply stubbed to {'refers': ['access panel'], 'same_as': {}, 'kind': {}} and the narration request raising a sentinel after last_prompt is set). CLI: payload_2b.py --command "<text>" --out DIR writes DIR/baseline.txt and DIR/details.txt (system + user) and prints a unified diff of the two USER prompts. Default command: Examine the hidden panel closely, then try to open it. The diff must show ONLY the SCENE Details bullets changing (removed: unfamiliar system files, government data, financial data; added: the Initiative’s selection files; Michelle’s research moves position).
STEP 5. Tests in test_details_probe.py (hermetic, stubs only): the three payload facts above, identical 2A hashes, config caps equal TRANSITION_CAPS, other experiments untouched, dry-run artifacts validate under the checker with --experiment details, frozen pre-details files byte-equal to HEAD (use git show in the test or compare against stored sha256 values you compute in step 1 and embed). Update check_door_probe.py to accept experiment 'details' in dry and artifacts modes exactly like 'transition' (arms baseline/details).
VERIFY: .venv/bin/python -m pytest scripts/ringer/stage7 tests/test_markdown_story_package.py -q -n0 passes (also run: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q -n0 -x -k 'affordance or 2b or package' and report any failure; if tests/test_affordance_map.py::test_whole_package_findings_match_recorded_gaps fails because of the Details change, STOP and report it without editing bench/affordance_known_gaps.json); ruff check and ruff format --check on the touched python files; dry runs + checker for grounded, transition and details; run payload_2b.py and include its diff in your final message. Final message: files changed, test counts, the payload diff, deviations.
